subprocessors.name: Amazon Web Services
services: Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides the cloud infrastructure on which the KovaaLab CRM CRM runs — compute, managed databases, object storage, and encrypted backups. AWS is KovaaLab CRM's primary hosting provider.

subprocessors.name: Anthropic
services: Anthropic provides large language models that power KovaaLab CRM's optional AI features, such as drafting, summarization, and data enrichment.

subprocessors.name: Azure
services: Microsoft Azure provides Azure Foundry model hosting and inference for KovaaLab CRM's optional AI features. Processing may include prompts, model responses, and CRM content supplied as context. The provider and processing geography depend on the model and deployment used; a European resource location does not guarantee EU-only processing for Global deployments.

subprocessors.name: ClickHouse
services: ClickHouse provides the analytical database KovaaLab CRM uses to store audit logs and power in-product analytics and reporting.

subprocessors.name: Cloudflare
services: Cloudflare provides KovaaLab CRM's content delivery network, DNS, and web application firewall, securing and accelerating traffic to the service. It does not retain Customer Personal Data on a long-term basis.

subprocessors.name: Google Cloud Platform
services: Google Cloud Platform provides specific Google services that KovaaLab CRM integrates, such as Maps and Google sign-in.

subprocessors.name: Mistral
services: Mistral AI provides large language models that power KovaaLab CRM's optional AI features. The AI provider used depends on the model configured for the workspace.

subprocessors.name: OpenAI
services: OpenAI provides large language models that power KovaaLab CRM's optional AI features. The AI provider used depends on the model configured for the workspace.

subprocessors.name: Sentry
services: Sentry provides application error and performance monitoring, helping KovaaLab CRM detect, diagnose, and resolve issues in the service.

subprocessors.name: TypeSafe
services: TypeSafe AI provides evaluation and monitoring of KovaaLab CRM AI features. Processing may include AI interaction content, such as prompts, responses, and contextual CRM data included in the interactions submitted for evaluation.
